Negative favors model. Exploratory county-cluster interval; not population-level evidence.

interpretation: Exploratory efficiency forecasting only. Temporal and spatial tasks have different baselines. Weather features use historical normals, not observed future weather. No causal or resource-stress claim.

config.note: The original 2025 baseline results were already seen. This is not preregistration or an untouched final test.
config.target: operator-reported quarterly PUE; not electricity, water or resource stress
config.test_weather: Only county climate from years before the target year is used, never realized target-year weather.
config.availability_assumption: Historical hindcast assumes preceding-year PUE is available at the nominal origin. Actual publication timestamps and reporting delays are not reconstructed.
config.spatial_holdout: Remove all PUE observations from the test county, including both Loudoun campus labels, before fitting.
config.uncertainty: Paired county-cluster bootstrap of mean absolute error differences; 2000 draws, seed 20261010. Seven counties are too few for broad population inference.
config.claim_gate: No model superiority, AI-only impact or future stress claim from this exploratory pilot alone.
